rca of the issue: convert-character-btn missing — likely a prop-gate race: CharacterSheet loads `ch` (the character doc) and `campaign` in parallel; ConvertCharacterButton mounts with `isGm = !!(campaign?.is_gm)` and on first render campaign is null → isGm false → button returns null. Since the null branch short-circuits, the button never re-mounts cleanly when campaign arrives. Fix: (a) wrap the button in `{campaign && <ConvertCharacterButton …/>}`, or (b) pass `isGm = user?.role==='admin' || !!(campaign?.is_gm)` so admins always see it. Either one-liner clears the issue.
